episode_summary: In this episode, D.J. Paris discusses how real estate agents can leverage AI to uncover hidden business opportunities within their existing contacts. He introduces five actionable AI strategies that improve prospecting, client communication, and time management. The episode emphasizes the importance of using AI to gain a competitive edge and enhance productivity.
